dialog.english:
There's no way that has anything
to do with the badge.
dialog.translation:
No puede tener nada que ver
con la insignia.

dialog.english:
That's it! The Numemon boss has
T.K's badge!
dialog.translation:
Eso es! El jefe Numemon
tiene la insignia de T.K

dialog.english: What?!
dialog.translation: Qué?!

dialog.english:
You're not saying... that T.K's
badge is actually that p-p-poo...
dialog.translation:
No me digas... que la insignia
de T.K es esa c-c-caca...

dialog.english: N-No! That's not what I meant!
dialog.translation: N-No! No quería decir eso!

dialog.english:
You see, T.K's badge was
actually a present from my dad.
dialog.translation:
Veréis, la insignia de T.K
era un regalo de mi padre.

dialog.english:
T.K loves ice cream,
so my dad thought he'd like a
badge shaped like one.
dialog.translation:
A T.K le encanta el helado,
y mi padre pensó que le
gustaría una insignia así.

dialog.english: What a nice dad!
dialog.translation: Qué padre majo!

dialog.english:
I get it! So that Numemon boss
mistook it for a lucky white poop!
dialog.translation:
Ya lo pillo! El jefe Numemon
la confundió con caca de
la suerte!

dialog.english: Let's go find the boss!
dialog.translation: Vamos a buscar al jefe!

dialog.english:
Hey, do you know where the Numemon
boss is?
dialog.translation:
Oye, sabes dónde está el
jefe Numemon?

dialog.english:
Hmm? I dunno 'bout complicated
stuff like that. I just live
'round here.
dialog.translation:
Eh? No sé de cosas tan
complicadas. Yo solo vivo
por aquí.

dialog.english:
But he should be somewhere 'round
the sewer.
dialog.translation:
Pero debe de andar por la
alcantarilla.

dialog.english:
By the way, missy, would you mind
accompanying me to...
dialog.translation:
Por cierto, señorita, le
importaría acompañarme a...

dialog.english:
I do N-O-T want to take a sewer
bath!
dialog.translation:
N-O quiero un baño en la
alcantarilla!

dialog.english: There he is!
dialog.translation: Ahí está!

dialog.english:
He's all squirmy, like the other
Numemon. I'm definitely getting a
bad vibe from him.
dialog.translation:
Es todo viscoso, como los
otros Numemon. Me da muy
mala espina.

dialog.english:
Nunuuu! Rude! Whaddya mean by
that?
dialog.translation:
Nunuuu! Grosero! Qué
quieres decir?

dialog.english:
That badge! It's mine! Can't you
give it back?
dialog.translation:
Esa insignia! Es mía! No
puedes devolvérmela?

dialog.english:
This symbol has been passed down
by boss Numemon for generations! 
Are you trying to start a fight?
dialog.translation:
Este símbolo pasa de jefe
Numemon en jefe Numemon por
generaciones! Quieres pelea?

dialog.english: No way.
dialog.translation: Anda ya

dialog.english: You're horrible!
dialog.translation: Eres horrible!

dialog.english: It's such an obvious lie.
dialog.translation: Es una mentira muy obvia.

dialog.english:
Aren't you the boss? Don't you
have any shame at all, lying like
that?
dialog.translation:
No eres el jefe? No te da
vergüenza mentir así?

dialog.english:
I got it from my dad when we were
separated. There's only one like
it... so give it back!
dialog.translation:
Me la dio mi padre cuando nos
separamos. Es única en su
tipo... así que devuélvemela!

dialog.english:
Nunuuu! I can't hear you when you
talk so quietly! Wahahaha!
dialog.translation:
Nunuuu! No te oigo si hablas
tan bajito! Wajajaja!

dialog.english: Now I'm angry!
dialog.translation: Me enfado!

dialog.english: Patamon!
dialog.translation: Patamon!

dialog.english:
I'll get it back for you, no
matter what!
dialog.translation:
Te la recuperaré, pase lo
que pase!

dialog.english: Do you really think so, kiddo?
dialog.translation: De verdad lo crees, chaval?

dialog.english: We'll back you up, Patamon!
dialog.translation: Te apoyamos, Patamon!

dialog.english:
We did it, T.K! We got your
badge back!
dialog.translation:
Lo logramos, T.K! Recuperamos
tu insignia!

dialog.english: Thank you, Patamon! Thanks, guys!
dialog.translation:
Gracias, Patamon! Gracias,
chicos!

dialog.english:
Well, you're like a little brother
to all of us, T.K.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, eres como un hermano
pequeño para todos, T.K.

dialog.english:
There's that disgrace of a boss!
Haven't you taken some time to
think about what you've done?
dialog.translation:
Ahí está el jefe deshonroso!
No has tenido tiempo de
pensar en lo que hiciste?

dialog.english: Yes! I'll be good!
dialog.translation: Sí! Seré bueno!

dialog.english: Will you really?
dialog.translation: De verdad?

dialog.english:
Please accept this as a token of
my regret, I beg of you!
dialog.translation:
Aceptad esto en señal de mi
arrepentimiento, os lo
suplico!

dialog.english: Can we really have this?
dialog.translation: Podemos quedárnoslo?

dialog.english: Take it, take it!
dialog.translation: Tomadlo, tomadlo!

dialog.english: Thank you, Boss!
dialog.translation: Gracias, jefe!

dialog.english:
If you would like, based on 
information we've recieved thus
far, I can locate the Numemon.
dialog.translation:
Si queréis, con lo que
sabemos hasta ahora, puedo
localizar al Numemon.

dialog.english: Please, Izzy.
dialog.translation: Por favor, Izzy.

dialog.english:
That's strange. My computer seems
to be malfunctioning...
dialog.translation:
Qué raro. Mi ordenador
parece que falla...

dialog.english: Hurry up, Izzy!
dialog.translation: Date prisa, Izzy!

dialog.english: It's my fault.
dialog.translation: Es culpa mía.

dialog.english:
Please don't panic. Let me try
restarting it...
dialog.translation:
No os asustéis. Voy a
intentar reiniciarlo...

dialog.english:
It's because we've spent so long
in this sewer, right?
dialog.translation:
Es porque llevamos mucho
tiempo en la alcantarilla,
no?

dialog.english:
Oh, no, it's just because of a
program error. Please don't worry
about it.
dialog.translation:
Ah, no, es solo un error de
programa. No os preocupéis
por eso.

dialog.english: Really? That's a relief.
dialog.translation: En serio? Qué alivio.
